tldr: Sun in the 9th house routes identity and life force through wisdom and expansion.
body: With the Sun in the 9th house, identity, vitality, visibility, and the need to live from a clear center move through belief, faith, travel, higher learning, publishing, and meaning. This makes how you search for truth, widen your world, and live what you believe a central part of the life. Used consciously, this placement can become presence, confidence, creative authority, and a stronger sense of purpose. Left unconscious, it can become over-identifying with this area, needing recognition here, or confusing attention with self-worth.
gift: presence, confidence, creative authority, and a stronger sense of purpose expressed through wisdom and expansion.
challenge: over-identifying with this area, needing recognition here, or confusing attention with self-worth concentrated in wisdom and expansion.
note: Authored from approved project planet-through-house material; source file was not copied into the repository.
